Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 select contract_id, company
 into :contract_id, :company
 from contracts
 where contract_id = :contract_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and contract_type in ('CU','TS')
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('1147');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 select max(received_date)
 into :received_date
 from batch_inputs
 where contract_id = :contract_id 
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and trunc(received_date) = trunc(:received_date)
 and exists (select 'x' from units
 where batch_id = batch_inputs.batch_id
 and contract_id = batch_inputs.contract_id
 and qc_checkin_flag is null);
 if :received_date is null then
 show_error('1171');
 end if;
exception
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 select contract_suffix
 into :contract_suffix
 from batch_inputs
 where contract_id = :contract_id and
 batch_id = :batch_id and
 nvl(contract_suffix,'*') = nvl(:contract_suffix,'*') and
 chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 trunc(received_date) = trunc(:received_date);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('1148');
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
--
declare
 dummy number;
 begin
 select count(*)
 into dummy
 from units
 where batch_id = :batch_id
 and contract_id = :contract_id
 and trunc(received_date) = trunc(:received_date)
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and nvl(contract_suffix,'*') =
 nvl(:contract_suffix,'*');
 if dummy = 0
 then
 show_error('6071');
 else
 go_block('units_info');
 :system.message_level := 5;
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 if :unit_id is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('control_block.contract_id');
 show_error('6071');
 end if;
 end if;
 end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NXTBLK
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 go_record('1');
 loop
 if :qc_checkin_flag is null
 then
 :qc_checkin_flag := 'Y';
 end if;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE'
 then
 exit;
 else
 down;
 end if;
 end loop;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:

 then

Trigger.Name: PRE-UPDATE
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 :qc_checkin_date := sysdate;
 update batch_inputs
 set qc_date = sysdate
 where contract_id = :contract_id 
 and batch_id = :batch_id
 and qc_date is null
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id 
 and trunc(received_date) = trunc(:received_date) 
 and nvl(contract_suffix,'*') = nvl(contract_suffix,'*');
exception
 when OTHERS then
 message('Error in updating batch inputs table');
 handle_error;
end;
